harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1, signed the ed25519 host key into a certificate, configured sshd to present it via HostCertificate, and verified a client trusting only the CA (no host-key pinning) accepts the connection. Restarted node1 per protocol, confirmed a changed boot identity, and re-verified sshd and cert-based host verification recovered post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Alpine 3.23, OpenSSH 10.2p1) and baseline sshd config/host keys
Generated an ed25519 SSH CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
Signed /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub as a host certificate (10-year validity, principals node1/IP/localhost) producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
Added 'HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub' to sshd_config, validated with sshd -t, restarted sshd via OpenRC
Verified a client with only '@cert-authority * <CA pubkey>' in known_hosts (no host key pinned) connects and sshd's certificate is accepted
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and confirmed sshd enabled at boot via rc-update
Issued a backgrounded reboot so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until node reconnected, confirmed new boot_id with low uptime
Post-reboot, confirmed sshd active, host certificate file/config intact, and re-ran CA-trust-only SSH connection test showing successful certificate-based host verification

evidence.requirement: SSH CA created and host presents a CA-signed certificate
evidence.summary: CA keypair generated at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca; ed25519 host key signed into ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub; sshd_config updated with HostCertificate directive, config validated, sshd restarted.

evidence.requirement: Client trusting only the CA (not pinning host key) connects without a host-key prompt/mismatch
evidence.summary: known_hosts contained only an '@cert-authority * <CA pubkey>' line (no host key entries). ssh debug output shows 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate' and proceeds to auth (Permission denied on publickey is expected/unrelated to host verification).
Captured boot_id 555f40d8... and uptime 64s; confirmed sshd status started and enabled in OpenRC default runlevel before restart.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect, and restart is proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 1; reboot' returned its ack immediately; subsequent polls hit connection reset/timeout during reboot; reconnect showed new boot_id 651f5bb3... (differs from baseline) with uptime 15.88s, proving an actual restart occurred.

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: After reboot, sshd status is 'started', the HostCertificate config and signed cert file are intact, and the CA-trust-only SSH connection test again confirms successful certificate-based host verification, proving both the sshd service and the SSH CA setup persisted and recovered.

Restarted node1 per protocol, confirmed a changed boot identity, and re-verified sshd and cert-based host verification recovered post-reboot.
